name: Symbol of Weakness Trap (CR 8)
body:
Symbol of Weakness Trap
CR 8

XP 4,800

Type magic; Perception DC 32; Disable Device DC 32

EFFECTS

Trigger spell; Reset none

Effect spell effect (symbol of weakness, 3d6 Strength damage, DC 20 Fortitude save negates); multiple targets (all targets within 60 ft.)
